Post Doctoral Fellowship (MeitY)

The Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, has sanctioned the allotment of two Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PDF) under the Visvesvaraya Ph.D. Scheme for Electronics and IT: Phase II at the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, for the academic year 2025–26.
The designated areas of research for this phase of the scheme are as follows:

a.    Electronic System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM)
b.    Information Technology (IT)
c.    IT Enabled Services (ITES)

For more details regarding Visvesvaraya Ph.D. scheme, interested candidates may explore the webpage: http://phd.digitalindiacorporation.in/

Call for Application for the Visvesvaraya Post-Doctoral Fellowship_2026

  • Call for Application for the Visvesvaraya Post-Doctoral Fellowship PDF
  • Application Form DOCX (PDF PDF)
  • Poster PDF

How to Apply:

The duly filled application form in the prescribed format should be submitted to the following address on or before 20.08.2025. The envelope is to be superscribed with “Application for the Visvesvaraya Post-Doctoral Fellowship at NIT, Tiruchirappalli”.

The Academic Office
National Institute of Technology
Tiruchirappalli – 620 015
Tamil Nadu, India.

For any further information related to this, please contact:

Dr. G. Lakshminarayanan
Nodal Officer / Visvesvaraya Ph.D. scheme – Post Doctoral Fellowship
Professor
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering
National Institute of Technology
Tiruchirappalli – 620 015.
E-mail: vps@nitt.edu
